title: Skills
intro: Skills are add-ons that give your clones new abilities. Each one is listed here with the result of its safety check.
loadFailed: Your skills could not be loaded.
empty: No skills are registered with this installation.
noStore: No skills are loaded, because there is no ucx-agent-skills folder in the project UClone-X was started from. To see how to add a skill, run this in a terminal window: ucx skill --help

plainCause.unreachable: UClone-X could not be reached. If it has stopped, start it again, then try again.
plainCause.status: UClone-X answered with an error but gave no reason.
plainCause.unreadable: UClone-X's answer could not be read.

codes.changed_after_approval: This skill was changed after it was approved, so it is not used. To use it, check what changed, then approve it again in a terminal window: ucx skill approve {name}
codes.approved_before_pins: This skill was approved before UClone-X began keeping a record of approvals on this computer, so it is not used until you approve it again. In a terminal window, run: ucx skill approve {name}
codes.never_approved: This skill is marked ready to use, but it was never approved on this computer, so it is not used. To use it, approve it in a terminal window: ucx skill approve {name}
codes.failed_safety_check: The safety check did not pass this skill, so it is not used.
codes.check_not_finished: The safety check could not read all of this skill's files, so it is not used. Check that its files can be opened, then start UClone-X again.
codes.unreadable: This skill's instructions could not be read, so it is not used. They may be incomplete or edited by hand. Fix them, or install the skill again.

reapprove.one: {names} was approved before UClone-X kept a record of approvals, so it needs approving again. In a terminal window, run: ucx skill approve {names}
reapprove.other: {count} skills were approved before UClone-X kept a record of approvals, so they need approving again. In a terminal window, run ucx skill approve for each: {names}

pending.label: Waiting for review
pending.hint: Needs a person to approve it

tab.search: Search skills by name, description, or tags...
tab.author: Author:
tab.noFindings: Nothing unsafe was found in this skill's code.
tab.choose: Choose a skill to see its safety check.

requiresTools.heading: Clones this skill is not offered to
requiresTools.remedy: A clone is offered a skill only when it has every tool the skill needs. To offer this one, add the missing tools to that clone's tools.
requiresTools.cloneHeading: Skills this clone is not offered
requiresTools.cloneRemedy: A clone is offered a skill only when it has every tool the skill needs. To offer one of these, add the tools it needs to this clone's tools.

proposals.heading: Skills your clones proposed
proposals.intro: A proposed skill is not used until you approve it. Read its instructions, then approve it or turn it down.
proposals.replaces: Replaces version {version}, which is in use now. What changes:
proposals.approved: {name} is approved and ready to use.
proposals.turnedDown: {name} was turned down and will not be used.
proposals.approveFailed: The skill could not be approved.
proposals.changed: This proposal changed after it was shown to you, so it was not approved. It is shown again below: look at it again, then approve it.
proposals.turnDownFailed: The proposal could not be turned down.

revoke.hint: Stop using this skill. Its files are kept, so it can be approved again later.
revoke.done: {name} is revoked and no longer used.
revoke.failed: The skill could not be revoked.

confirmWindow.unconfirmed: Only you can decide this, and this window was not opened by UClone-X, so it cannot tell that it is you. Open a window UClone-X confirms, then decide there.
confirmWindow.opened: A confirmed window was opened in your browser. Decide there.
confirmWindow.failed: A confirmed window could not be opened.
